name: Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick
site_label: campaign home page and Meet Patricia
bottom_line: This is her 2022 first-run site, never updated. It still says she will fight "bail laws written by our current Senator", though she has been the senator since 2023, and it has a footer link to her 2020 Assembly campaign. The biography itself checks out.
findings: Malverne trustee, police commissioner and deputy mayor roles are confirmed.
The page's copyright reads 2022 and it never mentions that she is the incumbent.
page_issues: Stale 2022 content presented as the current campaign site.
